title: Headless main-quest chain in Hardcore mode: the boulder-city chain (VMS20, the negotiator's path, to VMQ01 100 and VMQTops 10) with Boone along, the needs, ammunition weight, a Stimpak and a companion's death observed; docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: The boulder-city chain with Hardcore on from the start. Starts in Novac after VMQ01 50; Boone is free to hire (given: One for My Baby's outcome, VNPCFollowers bBooneAvailable). Speech 50 so the player can talk Jessup round.
Ammunition weighs something in Hardcore only (GECK wiki Ammo: weight 'only relevant in Hardcore mode'): 100 9mm rounds at 0.029 each.

actions.name: InventoryWeight
actions.label: milestone: carried weight with 100 9mm rounds (Hardcore ammunition weight)

actions.text: Boone on the dinosaur: the hire line (its begin script makes him a teammate). Stand-in: move_player to him.

Travel Novac to Boulder City. Stand-in: three hours of the clock (SetGameHour, which passes the hours as a wait does: the needs rise by those hours) for the walk or fast travel, then the player at the cell's COC marker; Boone comes along (a cell change brings teammates).

actions.label: Boone beside the player in Boulder City

actions.text: Lieutenant Monroe: the player offers to negotiate with the Khans (the player's pick ends his conversation; its begin script starts VMS20 at 10).
Jessup in the ruins: the player raises the hostages, then talks him into letting them go with Speech 45.
A long day in the ruins. Stand-in: the clock to 10 the next morning (19 hours as a wait). Dehydration passes its first stage (DEHY Water1): the stage's actor effect is on the player.

actions.label: milestone: the first dehydration stage's effect on the player

actions.text: The player drinks two Purified Waters (each takes 50 dehydration in Hardcore, times the Survival potency of a Food item): dehydration drops below the first stage and the stage's effect goes.

actions.label: milestone: the dehydration stage's effect gone after the water

actions.text: A Khan's shot stands in as 60 points of damage; a Stimpak in Hardcore heals over time (its Hardcore effect: 5 a second for 6 s, scaled by Medicine), not at once.

actions.label: milestone: health rising over the Stimpak's seconds

actions.text: Back to Monroe: the peaceful report ends VMS20 at stage 100.

Boone dies in a fight (stand-in: kill). Stand-in to check the wiki's rule, 'Essential flagged teammates are not essential in Hardcore': his base is first flagged essential (no companion of the masters is). In Hardcore he dies for good: no knockout, his teammate state cleared, his OnDeath sets VNPCFollowers bBooneDead; a day and a cell change later he is still dead and does not come along.

actions.label: Boone's teammate state after his death
milestone: Boone dead for good (VNPCFollowers bBooneDead)
milestone: Boone still dead a day and a cell change later

actions.text: Jessup's line about Benny: its begin script ends VMQ01 at 100 and starts VMQTops at 10.
